## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include relevant screen, role, and mobile changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` passed in `apps/workspace`.
- [ ] Repository hygiene passed; no local data, keys, reports or paused implementation was included.
- [ ] Changed workflows checked using synthetic records and actual authorization.
- [ ] Mobile, keyboard, reduced-motion and applicable themes checked.
- [ ] Documentation and affected architecture decisions reflect the final implementation.

## Release

Record remaining limitations, migration impact and exact deployment evidence when deployed. A green build does not establish hosted workflow acceptance.
